basic_details.offering_entity: École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL, Switzerland)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL, Lausanne, Switzerland)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all EPFL Master's programs: Computer Science, Data Science, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Life Sciences Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Materials Science, Civil & Environmental Engineering.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100 fellowships awarded annually across all EPFL schools
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition based exclusively on exceptional academic merit (typically 2 to 6 Pakistani awardees annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full duration of the Master's program (typically 4 semesters / 24 months, or 3 semesters for 90 ECTS programs)

nationality_requirements: Open to international students from all nationalities with an outstanding academic record
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed undergraduate degree (Bachelor's, 16 years education) with exceptional academic excellence, ranked in the top 5% of their graduating class.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Typically requires a CGPA of 3.70+ / 4.00 or top 5% class standing from an internationally renowned university.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial mathematical, algorithmic, and engineering training corresponding to the chosen master's field.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final undergraduate year graduating prior to autumn semester.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; scientific publications, competitive programming achievements, and elite research internships are highly prized.

english_proficiency.notes: English C1 level certificate recommended; Medium of Instruction certificate accepted if entire undergraduate program was taught in English.

eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: None; female candidates in engineering and computing actively encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Top-ranked global engineering and computing scholars.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not have already completed a master's degree at EPFL.

tuition_fee.details: Tuition fees at EPFL are modest (CHF 780 per semester); fellowship covers these fees or provides a direct waiver/allowance.

admission_application_fee.details: Application fee of CHF 150 (CHF 50 for Swiss degrees) paid on EPFL admissions portal.

accommodation.details: Guaranteed student housing reservation in Lausanne (FMEL residences); rent (~CHF 600–900/mo) paid from monthly fellowship stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: CHF 10,000 per semester (CHF 20,000 per year / ~CHF 1,666/month / ~PKR 525,000/month), which comfortably covers living expenses, rent, and local insurance in Switzerland.

airfare.details: International travel expenses borne by the candidate.

visa_fee.details: Swiss national visa fee (~CHF 80) and biometric residence permit (Permis B) in Canton de Vaud paid by student.

health_insurance.details: Mandatory Swiss health insurance for international students (e.g. Swisscare / Scorestudies ~CHF 65–85/month) paid from fellowship stipend.

food_allowance.details: Self-funded via grocery stores and EPFL campus cafeterias (~CHF 400/month).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: State-of-the-art supercomputing facilities, research labs, and EPFL Rolex Learning Center provided free.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Paid master's thesis research assistantships in EPFL laboratories during Year 2.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Priority reservation of room in student accommodation (FMEL) organized by EPFL housing office.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL, Lausanne, Switzerland).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: #26 QS World University Rankings 2025; #11 globally in Engineering & Technology; #9 in Computer Science.
available_majors: Computer Science, Data Science, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Life Sciences Engineering, Quantum Science & Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Materials Science
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree in engineering, computing, or pure science with top 5% class standing.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Computer Science and Data Science are among the most selective programs in the world.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Apply during the December 15 application window (Window 1) rather than the March 31 window, as most fellowships are allocated in the first round.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the EPFL online admission portal, select your Master's degree, tick the Excellence Fellowship box, and invite your three referees.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Register on EPFL online portal (opens mid-November).
3. Tick the checkbox to apply for Master Excellence Fellowship.
4. Upload CV, statement of purpose, academic transcripts, and diploma.
5. Register 3 referee professors who receive automated submission links.
8. Receive admission and fellowship decision in late February / early March.
9. Apply for Swiss student visa at Swiss Embassy in Islamabad.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic consideration via EPFL central master admission portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted directly by 3 referees through EPFL confidential electronic referee portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose (max 1000 words) explaining academic motivation, research trajectory, reasons for choosing EPFL, and future career vision.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV (max 2 pages) detailing GPA, rankings, coding competitions, research publications, and open-source contributions.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: None for Master's; decisions based entirely on application dossier.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE general test scores are optional but highly recommended for international applicants outside Europe.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Original certified transcripts and diploma. Verified by EPFL upon physical matriculation.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official English, French, German, or Italian translation of all academic records.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned copy of valid international passport
Complete transcripts for 16-year education with official grading scale
Confidential reference letters submitted electronically by university professors
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: From undergraduate faculty and research project supervisors

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1,000-word essay explaining academic trajectory and fit with EPFL
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Focus on technical achievements and specific EPFL labs

required_documents_checklist.specification: Concise 2-page academic CV detailing rankings, coding profiles, and publications
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight competitive programming and GPA percentiles

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Window 1 (December 15) offers the highest concentration of fellowship awards.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 65% (Undergraduate transcript grades, mathematics rigor, and class rank)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of vision, technical motivation, and lab alignment)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Admissions Committee of the respective EPFL Section / School (e.g. School of Computer and Communication Sciences).
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Central administrative screening -> Section academic committee evaluation and ranking -> Master Excellence Fellowship jury decision.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~7,500 international applicants across all Master's programs
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates from elite STEM institutions (NUST, FAST, GIKI, LUMS) with top 2% class standing, exceptional mathematical foundation, and strong recommendations.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Pakistani scholars regularly secure fellowships in Computer Science, Data Science, and Microengineering at EPFL.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: France, India, China, Italy, Germany, United States, Greece, Canada, Pakistan.

red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of CHF 150 is paid only through EPFL's official online application tool.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: EPFL has no commercial agents and never uses external recruitment intermediaries.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: Swiss visa processing fee and Vaud cantonal permit fees (~CHF 180 / ~PKR 56,000)
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: You need to speak French to study at EPFL. (Truth: All EPFL Master of Science programs in engineering and science are taught 100% in English).
MYTH: Living in Switzerland is unaffordable even with a scholarship. (Truth: The CHF 10,000/semester fellowship comfortably covers rent and living costs).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Commercial study consultants charge fees claiming to guarantee EPFL admission; EPFL selection is purely mathematical and academic.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must achieve excellent academic results (minimum average grade of 5.0 out of 6.0 in the Swiss grading system) to maintain fellowship for Year 2.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time study commitment at EPFL Lausanne campus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Passing first-year exams (at least 60 ECTS credits achieved) by the end of the academic year.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Permitted to work up to 15 hours per week during term time after 6 months of residence in Switzerland.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; Switzerland provides a 6-month post-study residence permit for graduates to seek employment.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Fellowship is discontinued if student fails required exam credits or drops below academic threshold.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Transferring to a different section is subject to approval and may result in forfeiture of the fellowship.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly limited to the standard study duration (3 or 4 semesters).
